## Is Your Feature Related to a Problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Describe the Solution You'd Like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe Alternatives You've Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Design Inspiration

If applicable, provide links to similar features in other projects or design systems:
- Material Design example: [link]
- Apple Human Interface Guidelines: [link]
- Other design system: [link]

## Implementation Ideas

If you have any thoughts on how this feature could be implemented, please share them here.

## Affected Components

Which Aurora components would be affected by this feature?
- [ ] Button
- [ ] Card
- [ ] Input
- [ ] Dialog
- [ ] DataTable
- [ ] Tabs
- [ ] Select
- [ ] Menu
- [ ] Breadcrumb
- [ ] Icon Dock
- [ ] Other: _____

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Cannot work without this
- [ ] High - Would significantly improve workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Enhancement, can wait
